title: Right off the bat, I'm NOT impressed!
text:
Right off the bat, I'm NOT impressed!. UPDATE: The seller was supposed to reach out to me for selling me a used set and issue me a refund and still hasn't months later!

Straight out of the package and these items look used! There are spots all over EVERY knife, along with some with scratches and faded lettering. A few utensils are dirty and scratched as well. The scissors look dirty/faded but will not come clean. You can tell the knives were all wiped down, as you can see the streaks. I'm very disappointed. It feels like a sturdy, durable set of sharp knives, but pawning used as new is a deal breaker for me. If it weren't for that, my ratings would be higher. Save your money and buy elsewhere! I'd sure like my money back.
